statement: (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); ∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∀ k : ℕ, 12 ≤ k → let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); (∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (n:ℝ)/32 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ))) ≤ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))) → (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); -(n:ℝ)/64 ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ)))) → (let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, let n : ℕ := 2^k; c*(n : ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0106 · 以常数 1/64 回到冻结的二次幂父题
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0106 · Recover the frozen dyadic target with constant 1/64

brief.zh: 引入三个前提，取两个阈值与 12 的最大值。在同一 k 代入有限比较，得到 n/32−n/64=n/64。
brief.en: Introduce the three hypotheses, take the maximum of 12 and the two eventual thresholds, then combine the inequalities at the same k to obtain n/64.
